text: The number of the stock balance is the count of `asset` rows, with the sum of `book_value` (DF-COL-037) and the sum of `holding_cost_to_date` (DF-COL-042), grouped by `holding_status` of `LOV-HOLDING`, for a segment scope of `LOV-SEGMENT` and an as-at date. The figure is computed from `rwb_asset` on every read and is stored in no second table: what a confirmation records is the figure, its scope, its as-at date and its owner in the local decision record. The behaviour of R-DIS-01 and R-DIS-02 is built by RWB-S5-E3019-APP and RWB-S5-E3020-APP; this story keeps the four legacy criteria word for word because the legacy key lists them, and proves the two take-on criteria on the balance those writes move instead of building a second take-on path.
why: FSD S5 A2.6.1 asks for 'a number' and names no measure, TSD S5 declares asset, listing and asset_sale only and no balance object, the Ownership Map holds no balance table, and the legacy masters give the same R-DIS-01 and R-DIS-02 criteria to more than one story, so a default has to be chosen or the story could not be built.
